fn apply(acc: Int, x: Int) -> Int
  requires (acc >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (x >= 0)) or (result == (acc + x)))
  ensures ((not ((x < 0) and ((acc + x) < 0))) or (result == acc))
  ensures ((not ((x < 0) and ((acc + x) >= 0))) or (result == (acc + x)))
  effects pure
  example (apply(10, -3) == 7)
  example (apply(7, -20) == 7)
  example (apply(0, -5) == 0)
  example (apply(7, 5) == 12)
{
  if ((x < 0) and ((acc + x) < 0)) then acc else (acc + x)
}

fn run(xs: List[Int], acc: Int) -> Int
  requires (acc >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (len(xs) == 0)) or (result == acc))
  ensures ((not (forall x in xs: (x >= 0))) or (result >= acc))
  effects pure
  example (run([], 4) == 4)
  example (run([10, -3, -20, 5], 0) == 12)
  example (run([-5, 2], 0) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => acc [h, ..t] => run(t, apply(acc, h)) }
}

fn balance(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == run(xs, 0))
  effects pure
  example (balance([10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12)
  example (balance([-5, 2]) == 2)
  example (balance([]) == 0)
  example (balance([-1, -2]) == 0)
  example (balance([5, -5, -1]) == 0)
{
  run(xs, 0)
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or (contains(xs, x) == (r != None)))
  ensures ((not result) or (forall i in 0..len(xs): ((xs[i] == x) == (r == Some(i)))))

  example (found_ok([1, 4], 7, Some(5)) == false)

  match r { None => not has(xs, x) Some(i) => ((i >= 0) and nth_is(xs, i, x)) }

  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (length([1, 4, 6]) == 3)
  example (length([]) == 0)
  example (length([7]) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + length(t)) }
}

fn binary_search(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (sorted(xs) and distinct(xs))
  ensures found_ok(xs, x, result)
  effects pure
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 6) == Some(2))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 5) == None)
  example (binary_search([], 3) == None)

  example (binary_search([7], 7) == Some(0))

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)

  effects pure

  ensures (result == ((i < len(xs)) and (xs[i] == x)))
  effects pure
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 4) == true)
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 1, 6) == false)
  example (nth_is([1, 4, 6], 3, 6) == false)
  example (nth_is([], 0, 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then (h == x) else nth_is(t, (i - 1), x) }
}

fn found_ok(xs: List[Int], x: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or (contains(xs, x) == (r != None)))
  ensures ((not result) or (forall i in 0..len(xs): ((xs[i] == x) == (r == Some(i)))))
  effects pure
  example (found_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(2)) == true)
  example (found_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, None) == true)
  example (found_ok([1, 4], 4, Some(0)) == false)
  example (found_ok([1, 4], 4, None) == false)
  example (found_ok([1, 4], 7, Some(5)) == false)
{
  match r { None => not has(xs, x) Some(i) => ((i >= 0) and nth_is(xs, i, x)) }
}

{

  requires (((lo >= 0) and (lo <= hi)) and (hi <= len(xs)))
  requires (sorted(xs) and distinct(xs))
  requires forall i in 0..lo: (xs[i] < x)
  requires forall i in hi..len(xs): (xs[i] > x)
  ensures found_ok(xs, x, result)
  effects pure

  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (2 * len(xs)))

{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [k, ..u] => ([h, k] ++ interleave(t, u)) } }
}

fn count_less(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures (((result == 0) and (forall x in xs: (x >= v))) or ((result > 0) and (exists x in xs: (x < v))))
  ensures (((result == len(xs)) and (forall x in xs: (x < v))) or ((result < len(xs)) and (exists x in xs: (x >= v))))
  effects pure
  example (count_less([], 3) == 0)
  example (count_less([7, 2, 9, 4], 5) == 2)
  example (count_less([7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == 0)
  example (count_less([7, 2, 9, 4], 10) == 4)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h < v) then (1 + count_less(t, v)) else count_less(t, v) }
}

fn pick(xs: List[Int], r: Int) -> Int
  requires ((distinct(xs) and (r >= 0)) and (r < len(xs)))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (count_less(xs, result) == r)
  effects pure
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], 0) == 2)
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == 7)
  example (pick([5], 0) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (count_less(xs, h) == r) then h else if (count_less(xs, h) < r) then pick(t, (r - 1)) else pick(t, r) }
}

fn kth_smallest(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires ((distinct(xs) and (k >= 1)) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (count_less(xs, result) == (k - 1))
  effects pure
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (kth_smallest([5], 1) == 5)
{
  pick(xs, (k - 1))
}

fn keeps_order(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or (len(ys) <= len(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (keeps_order([1, 2, 1, 3], [2, 3], 1) == true)
  example (keeps_order([1, 2, 1, 3], [3, 2], 1) == false)
  example (keeps_order([4, 5], [4, 5], 9) == true)
  example (keeps_order([1, 1], [], 1) == true)
  example (keeps_order([4, 5], [4], 9) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => (ys == []) [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then keeps_order(t, ys, x) else match ys { [] => false [g, ..u] => ((g == h) and keeps_order(t, u, x)) } }
}
